en-US.description: Legado 3.0 in the terminal: a TUI novel reader built with Rust and ratatui.
en-US.longDescription:
TLegado brings the Legado (Eread) 3.0 reading experience to the terminal. Built with Rust and ratatui, it offers a polished TUI with comfortable interaction. It consumes Legado JSON book sources: after importing sources you can search across sources, explore categories, switch sources, and apply content sanitization, while reading progress, shelf groups, and preferences are saved automatically.
It imports local TXT and EPUB books, supports custom sanitizing rules (including sandboxed QuickJS scripts), reading preferences, and Legado readConfig import. Data is stored in .tlegado under the user directory by default, configurable via TLEGADO_DATA_DIR or --data-dir; the CLI supports --import-source, --import-book, and related options.

zh-CN.description: 终端版阅读 3.0：基于 Rust 与 ratatui 的 TUI 小说阅读器。
zh-CN.longDescription:
TLegado 是终端版阅读 3.0，基于 Rust 与 ratatui，提供优美的 TUI 与完善舒适的交互。它支持 Legado（阅读 3.0）JSON 书源：导入书源后可以进行多源搜索、探索、换源与正文净化，阅读进度、书架分组与阅读偏好会自动保存。
支持导入本地 TXT 与 EPUB 图书、自定义净化规则（含受限 QuickJS 脚本）、阅读偏好与 Legado readConfig 导入。数据默认保存在用户目录的 .tlegado，可用 TLEGADO_DATA_DIR 或 --data-dir 指定；命令行支持 --import-source、--import-book 等参数。
